<!-- Generated by Ankus.DocGenerator. -->

Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Runs a custom scan in parallel: PostgreSQL's workers and the leader each read part of the rows, coordinating through
shared memory the provider lays out as <code class="typeparamref">TShared</code>.

```csharp
public interface IPgParallelCustomScan<TState, TShared> : IPgCustomScan<TState> where TState : class where TShared : unmanaged
```

Type parameters:

`TState`

The per-scan state, one in each process that runs the scan.

`TShared`

The shared memory's layout. Use [PgAtomicValue&lt;T&gt;](/api/ankus.pgatomicvalue-1/) fields for values processes update concurrently.

Offer parallel paths with [AddParallelPath(PgCustomScanPath, int)](/api/ankus.pgcustomscanplanner/#member-24e487b3b46a52b2). A provider that implements this interface
declares that its scans can run in parallel workers, so its other paths can run there too. PostgreSQL can still run a
parallel plan without workers, for example inside a cursor; the scan then gets no shared memory and must produce all
the rows itself.

### AttachShared(TState, PgCustomScanSharedMemory&lt;TShared&gt;)

Gives a process's scan the shared memory before its first read, in the leader after
[InitializeShared(TState, ref TShared)](/api/ankus.ipgparallelcustomscan-2/#member-3a6cb49fef3377dc) and in each worker after [Begin(PgCustomScanContext)](/api/ankus.ipgcustomscan-1/#member-3882d047fcb8947b).

```csharp
public static abstract void AttachShared(TState state, PgCustomScanSharedMemory<TShared> memory)
```

Parameters:

`state` — <code>TState</code>

This process's state.

`memory` — <code>PgCustomScanSharedMemory&lt;TShared&gt;</code>

The shared memory, valid until the scan ends.

### InitializeShared(TState, ref TShared)

Initializes the shared memory in the leader before workers start, and again before a rescan starts new ones.

```csharp
public static abstract void InitializeShared(TState state, ref TShared memory)
```

Parameters:

`state` — <code>TState</code>

`memory` — <code>TShared</code>
